WorkspaceSwitcher.label: Workspace
WorkspaceSwitcher.createDescription: A workspace holds its own companies, contacts, and deals.

Onboarding.title: Create your workspace
Onboarding.subtitle: A workspace holds your companies, contacts, and deals. Name yours to get started.
Onboarding.joinNote: Joining an existing team? Ask a workspace admin to add you.
Onboarding.joinInvalid: That doesn't look like a valid invite link.

InviteAccept.heading: Join {workspace}
InviteAccept.invalidBody: This invitation has expired or has already been used.
InviteAccept.mismatchBody: This invitation was sent to {email}, but you're signed in as {current}.

InviteLinkAccept.heading: Join {workspace}
InviteLinkAccept.invalidBody: This invite link has expired, been revoked, or reached its usage limit.

WorkspaceSettings.title: Settings
WorkspaceSettings.subtitle: Manage this workspace's name, its members, and how it works.

WorkspaceQualification.title: Qualification
WorkspaceQualification.description: Define what your team means by a qualified lead: the questions it answers about a contact, how much each one counts, and which ones must be met before a contact can be qualified.
WorkspaceQualification.archived: Criterion archived. Answers already recorded were kept.
WorkspaceQualification.noAccess: You can't change these. Ask a workspace admin.
WorkspaceQualification.requiredHint: A contact can't move to Qualified until this is met. It still counts for its weight, no more.
WorkspaceQualification.archivedHint: Archived questions stop counting, and stop holding anyone back. Answers already recorded stay on the contact.
WorkspaceQualification.emptyFit: Whether this is the right kind of customer at all — need, authority, budget, timing.
WorkspaceQualification.emptyEngagement: Whether the relationship is actually alive — replies, meetings, momentum.
WorkspaceQualification.emptyRequired: Mark a criterion required and a contact cannot be moved to Qualified until it is met.

dimensionEmpty.FIT: No fit criteria yet. These ask whether the contact is the right kind of customer.
dimensionEmpty.ENGAGEMENT: No engagement criteria yet. These ask whether the relationship is alive.

WorkspaceIdentity.title: Workspace identity
WorkspaceIdentity.description: The name people see, and the time zone your shared reports use.
WorkspaceIdentity.nameHint: This is the name everyone sees in Connex.
WorkspaceIdentity.slugHint: This ID appears in links and can't be changed here.
WorkspaceIdentity.timezoneAccountHint: Everyone's days start and end in their own time zone.
WorkspaceIdentity.timezoneOverrideHint: Shared reports count days in this time zone, for everyone.
WorkspaceIdentity.timezoneInvalid: Choose a time zone from the list.
WorkspaceIdentity.stale: Someone else changed these settings. Check the latest values and try again.
WorkspaceIdentity.noAccessBody: You can't change this workspace's name or time zone. A workspace admin can.
WorkspaceIdentity.permissionUnavailableBody: Try again before you make any changes.

WorkspaceData.title: Data
WorkspaceData.subtitle: Bring history from another tool into this workspace. Importing won't set off workflows or notifications.
WorkspaceData.historyDescription: Import past activities, notes, and tasks from a CSV file. You'll see who each one matched before anything is saved.

WorkspaceMembers.title: Members
WorkspaceMembers.subtitle: People with access to {workspace}.
WorkspaceMembers.inviteAccessSubtitle: Add teammates by email, share a join link, or auto-approve trusted email domains.
WorkspaceMembers.inviteMemberSubtitle: Invite by email, or share a join link anyone can use.
WorkspaceMembers.roleOptionsLoadFailedBody: Members and invitations are still here, but role choices aren't available right now. Try again.
WorkspaceMembers.inviteRoleUnavailableTitle: Invitations aren't available for your role
WorkspaceMembers.inviteRoleUnavailableBody: You can manage members, but you can't hand out everything the Member and Admin roles include. Ask a workspace admin to widen your access.
WorkspaceMembers.inviteSubtitle: Send an invite link. They join after signing in with the invited email.
WorkspaceMembers.memberInvited: Invitation sent — they'll see it in their notifications.
WorkspaceMembers.linkSubtitle: Anyone with the link can join with the role you choose. No email required.
WorkspaceMembers.domainsSubtitle: Restrict invite links to people whose email matches one of these domains.
WorkspaceMembers.domainsEmpty: No domain restrictions. Anyone with an invite link can join, regardless of their email.

WorkspaceRoles.title: Roles
WorkspaceRoles.subtitle: Give people exactly the access they need, and nothing more.
WorkspaceRoles.noAccess: Only workspace owners can manage roles.
WorkspaceRoles.builtInSubtitle: Standard access levels. These can't be edited.
WorkspaceRoles.createDescription: Pick a name and the exact actions this role can take.
WorkspaceRoles.noPermissionsHint: Choose at least one thing this role can do.

WorkflowAuthoring.noAccess: You can't manage workflows in this workspace. Ask a workspace admin if you need access.

system.title: Automation
system.hint: Runs with full workspace access. Owners and admins only.

WorkspaceWorkflows.title: Workflows
WorkspaceWorkflows.subtitle: Set up the work that should happen on its own.
WorkspaceWorkflows.accessDeniedTitle: You don't have access to workflows
WorkspaceWorkflows.emptyBody: Build your first workflow to automate a repeatable relationship task.
WorkspaceWorkflows.archivedEmptyBody: Archived workflows remain here with their versions and run history.
WorkspaceWorkflows.duplicateSystemRestricted: Only workspace owners and admins can duplicate Automation workflows.
WorkspaceWorkflows.listSummary: {record} · {steps, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} · {actions, plural, one {# action} other {# actions}}
WorkspaceWorkflows.graphLimitReached: This workflow is as big as it can get. Remove something to add something else.
WorkspaceWorkflows.fieldsLoadFailed: Couldn't load some of the panel options
WorkspaceWorkflows.fieldsLoadFailedBody: You can still edit everything else in this step. Try again to load them.
WorkspaceWorkflows.notFound: This workflow doesn't exist, or you can't see it.
WorkspaceWorkflows.runsUseActiveVersion: Until you publish, everything keeps running the current version.
WorkspaceWorkflows.systemValidationDenied: Your role can't build Automation workflows.
WorkspaceWorkflows.validationReady: Everything checks out. This draft is ready to publish.
WorkspaceWorkflows.validationErrorTitle: Fix {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}} before publishing
WorkspaceWorkflows.selectNodePrompt: Select a step to set it up.
WorkspaceWorkflows.selectNodeToInsert: Select the step to insert after.
WorkspaceWorkflows.invalidConnection: That branch can't connect to this step.
WorkspaceWorkflows.systemAuthoringRestricted: Only workspace owners and admins can build Automation workflows.
WorkspaceWorkflows.archivedReadOnly: Archived workflows are read-only. Restore this workflow from the list to edit it.
WorkspaceWorkflows.endExplanation: This branch completes the workflow without another action.
WorkspaceWorkflows.delayBoundsHint: Each wait must be 1 minute to 30 days. A path may wait for at most 90 days in total.

inspectorHint.trigger: Choose what starts this workflow, and whose permissions it uses.
inspectorHint.condition: Set the test this step makes, and where each answer goes.
inspectorHint.action: Choose one action and fill in what it needs.
inspectorHint.delay: Pause this path for a set amount of time.

canvasA11y.nodeDescription: Select a step with Enter. Move it with the arrow keys when editing is available.
canvasA11y.nodeKeyboardDisabled: This workflow is read-only, so steps can't be moved.
canvasA11y.nodeMoved: Step moved to horizontal position {x} and vertical position {y}.
canvasA11y.edgeDescription: Select this branch connection with Enter and remove it with Delete.

summary.delayMinutes: Wait {value, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
summary.delayHours: Wait {value, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
summary.delayDays: Wait {value, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

conflict.title: Resolve draft changes
conflict.description: Someone else changed the saved draft. Your own work is still here — choose which version to keep for each item.
conflict.autoMerged: The saved changes were merged with your local draft.
conflict.loadFailedBody: Your own work is still here. Try again.

simulation.title: Preview a workflow path
simulation.description: See what the saved draft would do to one record, without running it.
simulation.previewOnlyTitle: Preview only — no workflow will run
simulation.previewOnlyBody: You'll see which records match and the path they'd take. Nothing changes and nobody is notified.
simulation.unsupportedTitle: Preview is not available for document workflows
simulation.unsupportedBody: There's no way to pick a document to preview here. Publish the workflow, then check its run history.
simulation.failedBody: Nothing ran and nothing changed. Try again.

versions.title: Published versions
versions.description: Look at a published version without touching your draft.
versions.empty: No version has been published yet.

runs.title: Workflow runs
runs.detailDescription: What run #{run} did, step by step.
runs.legacyDetailDescription: What earlier run #{run} did, step by step.
runs.moreFailedBody: The runs already listed are unaffected. Try again.
runs.legacyVersion: Carried over from an earlier automation
runs.legacySummaryOnly: Only a summary was kept for this run

WorkspaceCustomFields.noAccess: Only workspace admins can manage custom fields.

dialog.description: Add a detail you want your records to keep.
dialog.keyInvalid: Enter a name that starts with a letter.
dialog.requiredHint: Must be filled before a record can be saved.
dialog.classificationHint: Flag fields that hold sensitive personal information.
dialog.classificationSpecialCareHint: Japanese privacy law calls this 要配慮個人情報 (special care-required personal information). Only collect it from people who have agreed to share it.
dialog.specialCareConfirmBody: Only fill in "{field}" for people who have agreed to share it. Japanese privacy law requires that.

WorkspaceEmail.title: Email
WorkspaceEmail.subtitle: Send this workspace's invitations from your own mail server. Otherwise Connex sends them for you.
WorkspaceEmail.enableDescription: When off, mail goes out from Connex's own address.
WorkspaceEmail.passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the password you already saved. You won't be able to see it again.
WorkspaceEmail.testSent: Test email sent. Check your inbox.
WorkspaceEmail.testFailedBody: The server didn't accept the message. Check the sending address, host, port, and credentials, then try again.

WorkspaceDelivery.title: Delivery
WorkspaceDelivery.subtitle: How this workspace sends campaign email — through your own mail server, or through a service built for sending in bulk.
WorkspaceDelivery.enableDescription: When off, campaigns wait here instead of going out.
WorkspaceDelivery.smtpNote: This uses the workspace's email settings. Nothing else to set up.
WorkspaceDelivery.apiKeyHint: Leave blank to keep the key you already saved. You won't be able to see it again.
WorkspaceDelivery.webhookDescription: Your email service tells Connex what happened to each message at this address. Generate the URL and secret below, then paste both into your provider's settings.
WorkspaceDelivery.webhookSaveFirst: Save the email service provider first, then generate a webhook token.
WorkspaceDelivery.revealTitle: Store these now — you won't see them again
WorkspaceDelivery.revealWarning: You'll only see these once. Copy them into your email service now — if you lose them, generate a new pair.
WorkspaceDelivery.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to delivery settings
WorkspaceDelivery.forbiddenBody: Ask a workspace admin for access to settings.
WorkspaceDelivery.smsSubtitle: Send campaign text messages through your SMS provider. Messages are plain text, from the sender ID below.
WorkspaceDelivery.smsEnableDescription: When off, SMS campaigns are held rather than delivered.
WorkspaceDelivery.smsSenderIdHint: Shown as the sender on the recipient's handset. Letters, digits, spaces, and + . _ - only.
WorkspaceDelivery.connectorsSubtitle: Send a campaign's finished audience to a list in another tool.
WorkspaceDelivery.connectorsEnableDescription: When off, you can't send audiences here.

WorkspaceSso.title: Single sign-on
WorkspaceSso.subtitle: Let people sign in with the login your company already uses. Connex works with OpenID Connect and SAML 2.0.
WorkspaceSso.enableDescription: Anyone with one of the email domains below signs in this way.
WorkspaceSso.enforceDescription: Block password and passkey sign-in for this organization's members — they must use the IdP.
WorkspaceSso.jitWorkspaceHint: New members are added to this workspace on first sign-in.
WorkspaceSso.oidcIssuerHint: Your provider's OpenID discovery URL. Connex works out the rest.
WorkspaceSso.oidcClientSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the current secret. You won't be able to see it again.
WorkspaceSso.samlMetadataHint: Paste your provider's metadata, or fill in the entity ID, sign-on URL, and certificate below.
WorkspaceSso.samlSpCertHint: Give this certificate to your provider so it can check that requests really come from Connex. Connex creates it when you save.
WorkspaceSso.domainsHint: One domain per line. Members with these email domains are routed to this IdP.
WorkspaceSso.saveFailed: Couldn't save the single sign-on settings
WorkspaceSso.loadFailed: Couldn't load your single sign-on settings.
WorkspaceSso.noAccess: You can't see these settings. Ask an organization admin.

WorkflowsLayout.description: Run actions automatically when records change or on a schedule
